caveats: Single run per configuration; CPU models differ (read environment), so cross-node differences are not a pure disk causal estimate.
Original packed preflight failed before replay; retry is a separate attempt with an administrative gap and isolated backend. Original failures remain failures.
fio lat_ns is per-I/O total latency, excludes final process close and separate fsync; total percentiles were not enabled and remain null.
API Throughput is documented as MB/s but byte-rate Bps is absent; measured throughput always uses bytes/2**20 MiB/s. Do not silently relabel API limits.
Diskstats span covers first-to-last low-frequency host sample, not every replay boundary. Request latency and queue metrics are block-layer aggregates.
Observer self CPU/RSS/bytes are measured overhead accounting, not an observer-on/off causal slowdown estimate. Output is on the system disk.
Host CPU and diskstats include cloud agents and observer. CPU steal is separately reported; io_ticks is not NVMe saturation proof.
No online freeze/fork cost claim; packed fixture preparation is offline and must remain separate from pure replay.
